title: "Submissions"
subtitle: "Your finished work"
---

Everything you turn in, in one place. Two ways to add work:

**Wrote in-site (Quarto):** render your `.qmd` to PDF/Word and link the source page below.
**Wrote elsewhere (Word, etc.):** drop the final file into the `submissions/` folder and link it.

When you finish an item, also mark its task `"done"` in `assets/tasks.js` so the dashboard updates.

## Starting a new response

Copy the template and rename it:

```bash
cp submissions/_response-template.qmd submissions/rr03-fasting.qmd
```

Then `quarto render submissions/rr03-fasting.qmd --to pdf` for a Canvas-ready file with the required formatting.
